description: The pie chart is divided into six segments, each representing a different category related to the Nondeterministic Polynomial-time Problem Challenge. The categories are Uncrushable, Complexity, Instance, Unhackable, Scalable Oversight, and Coverage. Each segment is color-coded and labeled with a corresponding icon. The Uncrushable segment is the largest, followed by Complexity, Instance, Unhackable, Scalable Oversight, and Coverage. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any visual emphasis on specific segments. The segments are ordered in a clockwise direction, starting from the top with Uncrushable and ending with Coverage.
